create_openai_client: create an OpenAI client configured with Hugging Face router base URL and HF_TOKEN authentication
create_chat_completion: create a chat completion call to a Hugging Face hosted model via the OpenAI-compatible API
configure_bill_to_header: configure the X-HF-Bill-To header to specify billing account for Hugging Face API requests
send_user_message: send a user message to an LLM model through the Hugging Face inference router
retrieve_completion_response: retrieve the assistant message response from a chat completion API call
